409_pose.text: The unit seems to respond to a horizontally elongated object seen side-on and standing on the ground on legs or wheels. This is a viewpoint and shape feature rather than a semantic category.

409_noun.text: Responds to dogs, and separately to cars and other road vehicles.
409_noun.source: noun-only control written by the orchestrator

55_face.text: The unit detects upright, front-facing faces of furry mammals, especially small carnivores such as foxes, cats, red panda, ferret and meerkat. It uses the local facial parts (eyes, muzzle/nose) on furry texture. A face-like car front (headlights plus grille) drives it more weakly.

55_or.text: The unit responds to two separate things: domestic cat faces seen at roughly whole-head scale, and passenger cars or trucks, especially glossy bodywork and front/hood views. The two have no obvious shared visual feature.

55_V.text: It is a V-shape neuron: pointed things drive it and round ones push it negative, whatever the label.
